migration.description: Create durable tasks, distinct parent/child and prerequisite relationships, and execution/history protection markers.

durable_state.description: Task business state is separate from execution state. Parent/child and prerequisite edges retain endpoint project ownership and are checked by the application for endpoint authorization and cycles. task_execution_refs reserves a stable protection boundary for future Sessions/Runs and retained results.
durable_state.storage_implementation: PostgreSQL tables managed by the embedded Goose migration history.

source_compatibility_range.earlier_state: The missing task tables are an unapplied migration; no earlier task state exists in the supported range.

ordered_operations.description: Create tasks with the five fixed business status values and restricted project ownership.
Create separate parent/child and prerequisite edge tables with database-level self-edge checks.
Create task_execution_refs as a durable deletion-protection marker for active execution and retained history.

rollout_signals: Goose records migration 00005 before task handlers can report readiness.
Relationship mutations serialize through a transaction advisory lock and check recursive reachability before commit.

validation: All five task statuses round-trip through PostgreSQL without changing execution markers.
Cross-project parent/child and prerequisite edges persist, while self-edges and recursive cycles are rejected.
Concurrent relationship writes serialize to one deterministic result and task deletion is rejected for relationships, active execution, retained history or an established session binding.
Task and relationship state remains readable after database close and reopen.
